lines.en: I head back to the dojo to practice with Ayane.
lines.zh: 我回道场和 Ayane 一起练习。

lines.en: The two of us get dressed and she begins to go over some of the basics of karate.
lines.zh: 我俩换好衣服，她开始给我讲空手道的一些基础。

lines.en: Of course, this quickly devolves into her becoming overly-affectionate and she winds up needing to take several breaks to 'reset' her emotions."
lines.zh: 当然，这很快就变成了她过度亲昵，最后她不得不中途休息好几次来「重置」情绪。"

lines.en: I learn next to nothing and leave the dojo no better at martial arts than I was when I arrived.
lines.zh: 我几乎什么都没学到，离开道场时的武术水平跟来时一样。

lines.en: But hey, at least I got to hang out with a cute girl...
lines.zh: 不过嘛，至少我陪一个可爱女孩待了一会儿……
